content:
Overview

Islamabad is a city in Islamabad Capital Territory with a population of 1,200,000. Pakistan’s planned capital city nestled at the foot of the Margalla Hills, known for its greenery, embassies, and high quality of life. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6a growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. A relatively small share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 260 sunny days a year. The population skews young, with a median age of 23.0.
